title: Where's Waldo? Query-language Preference under Cross-lingual Knowledge Disparities
abstract: arXiv:2610.00606v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Models increasingly serve as interfaces for knowledge-intensive information seeking tasks across languages by synthesizing multilingual evidence. Prior work has shown that they often exhibit query-language preference -- the tendency to favor sources written in the language of the query -- but has largely examined this behavior in settings where equivalent knowledge is available across languages. However, this bias becomes consequential when sources in different languages provide incomplete or inconsistent accounts of the same fact, since the information users receive then depends on the sources a model selects to use. To characterize query-language preference under such cross-lingual knowledge disparities, we introduce Waldo, a multilingual Question-Answering (QA) benchmark constructed from Wikipedia. translated_title: 威利在哪里？跨语言知识差异下的查询语言偏好
translated_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地通过综合多语言证据，充当跨语言知识密集型信息检索任务的接口。先前的研究表明，这类模型常常表现出查询语言偏好——即倾向于偏好与查询语言相同的文献来源——但已有工作大多是在各语言之间知识等价可得的情境下考察这一行为的。然而，当不同语言的来源对同一事实提供不完整或不一致的描述时，这种偏见就会变得至关重要，因为用户最终获得的信息取决于模型选择使用的来源。为了刻画这种跨语言知识差异下的查询语言偏好，我们提出了Waldo，一个基于维基百科构建的多语言问答（QA）基准。Waldo包含1.2万个针对知识缺口的问答对，即某一事实在一种语言中可得，而在另一种语言中缺失……
tldr: 该论文提出了基于维基百科构建的多语言问答基准Waldo，用于研究大语言模型在跨语言知识存在差异（即同一事实在一种语言中可得而在另一种语言中缺失）情况下的查询语言偏好问题。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Waldo, a multilingual QA benchmark built from Wikipedia, to characterize the query-language preference of large language models under cross-lingual knowledge disparities, where facts are available in one language but absent in another.
